brief.scope: Audit documentary correction custody only, using ops/process/{pipeline,tdd,cross-review}.md and supplied original records plus repository records/history. Scope: GPT-6 interface/unit1a and discovery-contract changes reviewed by Claude, where root Codex may have adjudicated its own harness's artifacts before correction. Do not adjudicate substantive findings in this audit or inspect runtime. Identify each exact CHANGES/source/fix sequence lacking the required third harness; distinguish later APPROVE from historical sequencing compliance. Recommend the smallest prospective, verifiable repair using original artifacts/reports, preserving every invalid attempt and commit, without rewriting history or inventing a waiver. Name missing evidence explicitly. Return a bounded review/report with exact refs and commands; no edits, live state, full floor or approval request. This audit must not silently approve its own findings or reclassify history.

Custody audit only of GPT-6 interface/unit1a and discovery-contract corrections reviewed by Claude. Law: ops/process/cross-review.md (CHANGES is adjudicated by a harness that produced neither artifact nor finding, before work; adjudicator gets the reviewed SHA and reports verbatim and nothing else); pipeline.md / AGENTS.md (no producer owns two consecutive artifacts); tdd.md (review reads records and refuses producer-as-judge). Producer harness is Codex (GPT-6). Finder is Claude. Required adjudicator is Grok. This session did not inspect runtime, did not walk live job directories outside the snapshot and supplied in/, and did not rule any substantive documentary finding.

Sequences lacking third-harness adjudicate (exact): A e076d5 CHANGES at 8d5d256 -> 20b3d6/8fd333e with no ruling file; B e4968e CHANGES at 8fd333e -> invalid dce07d/f15ca22 with missing interface-final-ruling.md; C fa4a72 CHANGES at f15ca22 -> b30b94/b0dfb69 with missing unit1a-fix-ruling.md; D eb9a02 CHANGES at 51ff07e -> 18ec12/48277e7 with missing discovery-contract-fix-ruling.md. python3 listing of .dev/records/dispatches adjudicate ids >= 20260906T104703 returns []. Later APPROVE (0e4580, aa0cb7, 02a617) rechecked later bytes and is not UPHELD/PARTIAL/REJECTED of the original CHANGES, not a waiver, and not sequencing compliance. 6c74e4/3f84832 acting on 0e4580 leftover p3 is a later step, not a cure of C.

Missing evidence, named: the four ruling markdown blobs at the sha256 values above; any Grok (or other third-harness) adjudicate record/RULING.md for A-D; recovered job in/ copies of those rulings (not looked outside snapshot/in/; could not look live dispatch trees). Original Claude records are present and hash-match the supplied in/ files.

Smallest prospective repair, no history rewrite, no invented waiver, preserve every invalid attempt and commit (including dce07d invalid, 3ee48f0, c35ed64/conduct-unit1a-20260906 split patches, 8fd333e, f15ca22, b0dfb69, 51ff07e, 48277e7, 3f84832, all dispatch records): recover the four ruling files by sha256 into an archive if they still exist in original job in/ (evidence only, not a ruling). Only after those rulings may any remaining UPHELD item be corrected in new commits; REJECTED over-fixes stay in history.
